I-001.threat: Eavesdropping on incoming data: Attacker intercepts sensitive data flowing to {{targetName}}
I-001.cause: Unencrypted or weakly protected communication channel between {{sourceName}} and {{targetName}}
I-001.attack: Attacker passively monitors the data flow and reads sensitive payload transmitted from {{sourceName}} to {{targetName}}

I-002.threat: Eavesdropping on response: Attacker intercepts sensitive response data from {{targetName}}
I-002.cause: Unencrypted or weakly protected response channel — response data is readable in transit
I-002.attack: Attacker intercepts the response from {{targetName}} to {{sourceName}} and reads sensitive information
